name: Divergent Fist

messages.welcome: I'll keep moving forward no matter what.

quotes: I'll keep moving forward no matter what.
Even if I die, I'll die surrounded by allies.
I don't need a reason to help someone.
I'll stop you here, even if it kills me.
As long as I'm alive, I'll keep punching.
Divergent fist — the second hit lands harder.
